data.name: Mirrorless camera
data.description: A 24-megapixel body with the 24–70 mm zoom, two batteries and a 128 GB card. Charges over USB-C.
data.imageAlt: A black mirrorless camera with a zoom lens, from the front

data.name: Compact video camera
data.description: 4K video camera with a flip-out screen and a top handle. Two batteries; the charger is in the bag.
data.imageAlt: A compact video camera with a flip-out screen, from the side

data.name: Tripod with video head
data.description: Aluminium tripod up to 1.6 m with a fluid head and its own carry bag. Takes both cameras.
data.imageAlt: A tripod with a fluid video head and a long pan handle

data.name: Laptop 14″, silver
data.description: 16 GB memory, 512 GB disk, the office printer already set up. The charger is in the sleeve.
data.imageAlt: A silver 14-inch laptop, open, its screen showing a blue desktop

data.name: Laptop 14″, graphite
data.description: 16 GB memory, 512 GB disk. The one with the slide software for client visits.
data.imageAlt: A dark graphite 14-inch laptop, open, its screen showing a green desktop

data.name: Laptop 16″ for video
data.description: 32 GB memory and the video editor installed. Heavy: take the padded bag.
data.imageAlt: A 16-inch laptop, open, a video timeline on its screen

data.name: Field audio recorder
data.description: Two built-in microphones and two inputs for the wireless pair. Takes AA batteries; spares are in the drawer.
data.imageAlt: A handheld field audio recorder with two crossed microphones on top

data.name: Wireless microphone pair
data.description: Two clip-on transmitters and one receiver for the camera or the recorder. Charge them the night before.
data.imageAlt: Two small wireless microphone transmitters and a receiver

data.name: LED light panels, pair
data.description: Two warm-to-cool panels on short stands, with their mains adapters and a battery each.
data.imageAlt: Two flat LED light panels on short stands, glowing warm white
